name: ModelVariant815_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant815_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (at the opposing slot, shards appear one after another and break into four animated quarters, a three-layer glow rises and stretches above them, a growing textured cone is drawn at three scales, and falling sparks and embers spill out while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the shards, sparks and embers and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 1 once on the first drawn frame, 2 once the last shard has finished animating after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-832 and 929 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
